summary: Completed comprehensive testing of EventDetailsPage redesign with StubHub-style interactive venue maps and grouped ticket sections. All features working correctly.

InteractiveVenueMap.jsx: SVG venue maps work for concert, football, and F1 events with section highlighting and click filtering

Backend events.py: Returns grouped_sections array with correct structure (category, section, count, lowest_price, highest_price, tickets[])
seed_data_creation: None - used existing event concert_ac2e6adb1dd3 (John Legend) and premium_e24200a25464 (Arsenal vs Tottenham)
